name: dark-forest-local
description: Unlimited local Sponsored FPC. Its FeeJuice balance is the total sponsorship budget.
_comment_allowedTargets: Resolved from the deploy environment. Same six player-facing contracts as mainnet; Admin and Config stay excluded so the local run exercises the real allowlist rather than a permissive one.
_comment_allowedAccountClasses: Mirrors mainnet: only the initializerless Schnorr class the embedded wallet uses. The plain (published) SchnorrAccount is excluded because a published account can upgrade itself via ContractInstanceRegistry::update — see requireUnpublishedAccounts. Ids are recomputed from the installed artifacts at deploy time.
